deliverable.source_excerpt: <!doctype html> <html lang="hi"> <head> <meta charset="utf-8"> <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"> <title>Employment & Work Hub — Shirmani Research Institute</title> <style> :root{--gold:#d4af37;--bg:#0f1016;--card:#171a22;--text:#f8f9fa;--muted:#b8bdc7;--blue:#00d2ff} *{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,rgba(212,175,55,.12),transparent 55%),var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;line-height:1.6} main{max-width:1180px;margin:auto;padding:28px 18px 60px}h1,h2{color:var(--gold)}h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,3.3rem);margin-bottom:8px}.lead{font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:920px}.bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:18px 0}.bar a,.btn{display:inline-block;color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.45);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 13px;background:rgba(212,175,55,.08);font-weight:700}.bar a:hover,.btn:hover{background:var(--gold);color:#000} .hero{border:2px solid var(--gold);border-radius:20px;padding:24px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(212,175,55,.16),rgba(0,210,255,.06));margin:20px 0}.status{display:inline-block;padding:5px 10px;border:1px solid var(--blue);border-radius:999px;color:var(--blue);font-weight:800;font-size:.82rem} .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:
